energyexchange.help: /ee balance | value | learn | burn [count|all] | buy <item> [count] | list [page]. Burn learns; learn consumes 1 item. Survival/adventure only.
energyexchange.burned: Converted %s × %s and learned it. Balance: %s Energy.
energyexchange.error.amount: Invalid amount; use a positive whole number within the supported limits.
energyexchange.error.overflow: Energy limit exceeded (128 decimal digits). Nothing was exchanged.
energyexchange.error.knowledge_full: Knowledge storage is full. Nothing was consumed.
energyexchange.error.not_learned: You have not learned this item.
energyexchange.error.account_corrupt: Account data is invalid or from a newer version. Trading is locked; ask the server owner to restore a backup. Existing data was preserved.
energyexchange.error.rules_unavailable: Rules are loading or the last reload failed. Ask the server owner to fix the data pack and run /reload.
energyexchange.error.no_value: This item has no enabled Energy rule or is unavailable.
energyexchange.error.gamemode: Trading requires a living player in survival or adventure mode.
energyexchange.error.empty_hand: Place an item in the input slot, or hold it in your main hand when using commands.
energyexchange.error.components: Only default items are supported. Modified, named, enchanted, damaged or filled items cannot be exchanged.
energyexchange.error.count: Invalid quantity or not enough items in the input/main hand.
energyexchange.error.already_learned: You already know this item. No sample was consumed.
energyexchange.error.inventory_full: Your inventory cannot hold the entire purchase. No Energy was spent.
energyexchange.error.internal: Exchange failed. Please check the server log.
energyexchange.ui.title: Transmutation
energyexchange.ui.unknown: Not learned: convert a valid item first
energyexchange.config.title: Energy Exchange settings
energyexchange.config.invalid: Invalid value or settings file; unable to save.
energyexchange.config.server_note: XP settings are local server defaults, applied next time a world/server starts. Multiplayer uses the server owner’s settings.
energyexchange.error.xp_disabled: XP purchases are disabled by the server.
energyexchange.error.xp_limit: XP amount or current experience exceeds the safe limit.
energyexchange.error.stale: Prices or transaction state changed. Review the refreshed quote and try again.
energyexchange.error.busy: Please wait briefly before trading again.
energyexchange.error.small_batch: Use a larger batch: this input is worth less than 1 Energy.
energyexchange.ui.burn_rate: Conversion: %s Energy each (batch total rounded down)
energyexchange.name: Energy Exchange
energyexchange.ui.empty: Place items in the left slot, then Convert all to gain Energy and learn them.
energyexchange.ui.no_results: No matching items. Try switching to All items.
energyexchange.ui.burn_hint: Convert the entire input stack and learn it automatically. Requires an enabled Energy rule and supported components.
energyexchange.config.pinyin_hint: Off by default. Search Chinese names with full pinyin, initials, mixed Chinese/pinyin, tones or full-width letters. Multiple readings are supported. No REI or network required; this is not typo correction.
energyexchange.error.purchase_count: Choose 1, 16, 32 or 64, without exceeding the item stack limit.
